steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Media industries encompass the organisations that produce, distribute, and regulate media products — from global conglomerates to independent producers. | Key Fact: Media ownership: conglomerates (e.g. Disney, Comcast, Warner Bros. Discovery) own multiple media companies across different platforms. This concentration of ownership raises concerns about diversity and democratic plurality. | Key Fact: Vertical integration: a company owns different stages of production and distribution (e.g. Disney makes films and distributes them through Disney+). Horizontal integration: a company buys competitors at the same stage (e.g. Disney buying Fox). | Key Fact: Convergence: the merging of previously separate media industries and technologies — e.g. smartphones combining cameras, music player
